subject: Compressed demo window + exec coverage plan for Cyclone

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Tan <sara.tan@cycloneinc.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2026 09:12 -0700
Subject: Intro & demo — short two-hour window?

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — great to hear about Cyclone's use cases for streamlining billing reconciliation. Per our conversation, would your team be open to a compact, two-hour briefing + demo where we:

- Spend ~30–40 minutes on leadership-level outcomes (VP/CIO)
- Follow with ~75–90 minutes of product walkthrough + Q&A with engineering

We can run the demo on a safe subset of your data (no PII) and bring the latency/cost tradeoffs up front. Two candidate windows from our side:

• Tue Aug 11 — 14:00–16:00 ET
• Wed Aug 12 — 10:00–12:00 ET

Can you confirm whether your VP or CIO can join the first chunk (leadership outcomes)? If not, is the CTO available to cover the leadership portion? If useful I can also propose a brief pre-brief for executives 20–30 minutes before the demo.

I’ve CC'd Karthik to surface coverage options (ops + sales engineering).

Quick ask: please loop in procurement/ops if the later demo needs deeper infra questions so we can bring the right folks.

Thanks,

Avery Johnson
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0196
